title: Local cohomological dimension: generator and proper-sum bounds
statement: Let $A$ be a nonzero commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. For a finitely generated ideal $K$ of a ring $A$, write $H_K^j(M)=R^j\Gamma_K(M)$, where $\Gamma_K(M)=\{x\in M:K^nx=0\text{ for some }n\}$, and let $\operatorname{cd}(A,K)$ be the least integer $q\geq-1$ such that $H_K^j(M)=0$ for every $A$-module $M$ and every $j>q$. For every proper finitely generated ideal $I$ generated by $r\geq0$ elements, $0\leq\operatorname{cd}(A,I)\leq r$. If $I,J$ are finitely generated ideals with $I+J\ne A$, then $\operatorname{cd}(A,I+J)\leq\operatorname{cd}(A,I)+\operatorname{cd}(A,J)$. In particular, if $f_1,\ldots,f_e\in A$ and $I+(f_1,\ldots,f_e)\ne A$, then $\operatorname{cd}(A,I+(f_1,\ldots,f_e))\leq\operatorname{cd}(A,I)+e$.
